Rahul Pillai
DevOps Engineer | Chennai
rahul.pillai455@example.com | +91 9422146964

A results-driven DevOps Engineer with a strong focus on cloud-native platforms, automation and reliability. Experienced in designing and operating CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and container orchestration to accelerate delivery and reduce operational overhead. Seeking to apply scalable automation and SRE practices to improve system availability and deployment velocity.
Notice period: 60 days

Experience

DevOps Engineer (Remote)

- Containerized microservices using Docker and standardized base images, cutting image build times by 40% and lowering production incidents tied to environment drift. (Docker)
- Deployed and managed Kubernetes clusters with automated autoscaling and pod disruption budgets, improving service availability to 99.95% across critical services. (Kubernetes, AWS)
- Automated blue/green deployment flows in CI/CD to shorten release windows by 50% and rollback time to under 2 minutes for key services. (CI/CD, Git)

Bluefin Logistics — Oct 2025 - Mar 2026
Site Reliability Engineer (Onsite)
- Built Jenkins pipelines to orchestrate automated builds and deployments for logistics microservices, increasing deployment frequency from weekly to daily. (Jenkins, CI/CD)
- Dockerized legacy components and migrated them to container-based workflows, reducing environment parity issues by 60%. (Docker)
- Instrumented AWS-hosted services with alerting and runbooks, cutting mean time to detect (MTTD) by 45% and mean time to recovery (MTTR) by 35%. (AWS, Linux)
- Collaborated with development teams in Agile sprints to implement service-level objectives and capacity planning, improving SLA adherence.

Cloud Engineer (Hybrid)

- Standardized Docker image lifecycle and vulnerability scanning in CI pipelines, lowering CVE exposure and accelerating hotfix delivery. (Docker, CI/CD)
- Led platform improvements for logging and metrics collection, increasing observability and enabling quicker root cause analysis during incidents. (Linux, Git)
